notes: Fixed: on tall narrow cards the weather card painted its high and low temperatures past its own edges, and on short ones the condition and the two temperatures together were wider than the card they sat in.
Fixed: a rune name and a long reading could each lose their last letters where a column had been squeezed — MICROPHONE, FULLY CHARGED, the humidity figure.
A card with a single reading no longer splits its space into two columns, one of which was always empty.

Every rune was re-checked at 1485 card sizes — fifteen runes, nine card shapes, every strip height across the slider — with every value set to the longest it can ever be. Nothing is cut off and nothing is drawn below the readable size.
